commit 629a0d7be90f9549ee3bb544ea24492ae7444c4f
Author: Ty Barho <t.barho@gmail.com>
Date:   Fri Oct 2 10:30:20 2026 -0500

    fix: treat zombie router processes as stopped; run the container job with an init
    
    Without an init in the container, a stopped detached router lingers as a
    zombie that still answers kill(0). isAlive now checks /proc/<pid>/stat.
